description: This PHP source file defines the DirectoryServiceDataClient class used to interact with AWS Directory Service Data. It mainly contains method annotations for various API operations such as creating, deleting, describing, and listing directory members, groups, and users.

classes.name: DirectoryServiceDataClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Directory Service Data API, extending the base AwsClient and providing methods for directory management operations.

methods.name: addGroupMember
methods.description: Adds a member to a group.

methods.name: describeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific group.

methods.name: describeUser
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific user.

methods.name: listGroupsForMember
methods.description: Lists groups for a specified member.

methods.name: removeGroupMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a group.

methods.name: searchGroups
methods.description: Searches for groups based on criteria.

methods.name: searchUsers
methods.description: Searches for users based on criteria.
